_comment: Film 24 slot metadata (format as films/19-biocomputer/audio/clips.json). 'dur' (seconds of real footage/audio) is set when the footage is cut; until then build_vo.py uses the planned slot lengths 'plan' (the data root clips/clips.json 'dauer' also replaces them). 'offset': footage starts this long after the slot opens. 'cues': [[seconds from first footage frame, subtitle line]] for spoken clips (C1, C3, C5); none = no clip subtitle (atmo clips C2, C4 and the pig calls).
